lead: Cold messages still work, but they land in inboxes full of identical automated messages. What builds up is the opposite: useful answers in public, a free office hours for questions and a lead magnet that shows how you diagnose. People who arrive through them have already seen you work.
objetivo: set up the free office hours and a lead magnet that show diagnosis, not building, and set the date of the first office hours.

aprende.t: Choose the channel that suits you
Answer in public without sounding like a salesperson
Set up the free office hours for questions
Create a lead magnet that shows your diagnosis

hero_alt: A consultant runs an online office hours session for questions, with several participants on a video call.

secoes.titulo: The wheel that turns on its own
secoes.sub: You deliver value, you record the delivery, and the record delivers value again.

nos.detalhe: Public forums and communities in the industry you want to serve (outside the AI world). There, people describe the problem in their own words, and what is obvious to you looks rare.
Fixed schedule, no complicated sign-up. Anyone can join, ask, and you solve it live with your screen open. Live mistakes show that you really do the work.
A checklist or mini diagnostic that people use on their own and that shows how you think: the 4 checkpoints, the 3 questions, the baseline. High perceived value, low time from you.
Each session yields a few publishable excerpts. When a client asks for a case, you send the archive. Recorded proof beats a résumé.

secoes.volta: The archive brings new people to the office hours.
secoes.legenda: Choose the channel based on your personality, not on some guru's recipe. A routine abandoned after three weeks costs more than any channel.

secoes.sub: What works and what burns your name.

texto: Answer the question right there, with the real step by step and what usually goes wrong.
Say so when the simplest solution is not your specialty. Never "I messaged you privately" in place of the answer.
People recognize text that was generated and published without review. It dilutes your brand.
First answer in depth on high-reach posts; only then publish your own material.
"Comment one word and I'll send you the template" gets reach and bills you in the meeting.
Whoever hands out what they did not build cannot say why it was made that way or what breaks in the client's case.
Material published for free that any technical person can check in five minutes.
Careless delivery has the opposite effect: with no instructions and no example that runs, people conclude the paid work is the same.

secoes.sub: The lead magnet shows diagnosis. The build, if it comes, comes later, inside a service.

blocos.rot: Lead magnet · readiness mini diagnostic (10 questions)
blocos.conteudo:
MINI DIAGNOSTIC: IS YOUR COMPANY READY FOR AI?
Answer yes or no. Count the "yes" answers.

PROCESSES
1. Can someone describe the main process from start to finish?
2. Is that process written down somewhere?
DATA
3. Is there an official place where people look before asking someone?
4. Does each important document have an owner and a date of its last review?
SUPPORT
5. Does leadership know about and support the AI initiative?
6. Is there a separate budget for it?
SYSTEMS
7. Have you already connected two systems without copy and paste?
8. Does someone know who holds the admin password for each tool?
MEASUREMENT
9. Do you currently measure the time or error rate of the process you want to improve?
10. Can you say which number the project needs to move?

8 to 10: ready for a pilot.
4 to 7: start with preparation (process and data).
0 to 3: start with training the team.

<Your name> · free Q&A office hours: <day and time> · <link>

Free office hours for AI questions in <area/industry>
Every <day of the week>, from <time> to <time>, at <link>.
No sign-up. Bring your question or your process: I'll solve it live,
with my screen open, and I'll also tell you when AI is not the answer.
What I don't do here: <e.g., access to your company's systems, client data>.

blocos.rot: Prompt · specification for your lead magnet
blocos.conteudo:
You are an AI consultant and you will specify a free lead magnet that shows
how I diagnose, buildable in up to 1 hour.
My niche: <sector>
Job title of the person I want to attract: <job title>
Most repeated pain I see: <in one sentence>

Deliver:
1. Three lead magnet ideas (checklist, mini diagnostic, baseline
   spreadsheet), from the most obvious to the most surprising.
2. For the best one: what the person answers, what they get back and what
   decision they can make on their own with it.
3. The 3 cases where the lead magnet gives a bad answer, and how to warn about that in it.
4. The one-line sentence to promote it.
Nothing that requires access to the company's systems.

secoes.sub: Start small and keep it going for ninety days.

exercicios.texto: Adapt the mini diagnostic to your niche (or use the prompt for another lead magnet). Test it with an outsider before publishing.
exercicios.pronto: the lead magnet is published or ready to send, requires no system access at all, and ends by pointing to the next step (preparation, pilot or training).

exercicios.titulo: 2 · Date of your first office hours
exercicios.texto: Pick a fixed day and time, write the announcement, and share it in the channels where you already answer questions.
exercicios.pronto: your first office hours has a date on your calendar and the announcement is published in at least one channel.

secoes.sub: 4 questions. The explanation appears after your attempt.

perguntas.p: Where does your AI knowledge look the rarest?
opcoes: In communities of the industry you want to serve
perguntas.explica: Inside the AI world, everyone knows the basics and you don't stand out. In an accounting group, the same practical answer becomes a reference.

perguntas.p: Someone asks in a forum how to solve a problem. Which answer builds trust?
opcoes: The full answer right there, including what usually goes wrong
A canned text pasted into twenty discussions
perguntas.explica: Your public history of useful answers gets indexed and is found later by people with the same problem. Taking it to private feels like a sales pitch.

perguntas.p: Which lead magnet fits someone who sells trust?
opcoes: A ready-made bot the person installs in their company
A mini diagnostic that shows how you think and points to the next step
perguntas.explica: The lead magnet shows diagnosis, which is what you sell. A ready-made product turns into support, billing and competition; a list of tools decides nothing.

perguntas.p: What makes free office hours sustainable?
opcoes: A fixed time and a record of the sessions in short excerpts
Changing the time to fit your schedule
perguntas.explica: The quality of the distilling matters more than the size of the audience. Three people well served and well recorded are worth more than thirty passive listeners.

itens.t: The pain is written in public
itens.texto: Forums and industry communities, outside the AI world.
The routine you can sustain is worth more than the trendy channel.
Solving live and publishing the excerpts is recorded proof.
It shows how you think and ends by pointing to the next step.
